caption:
The Mood of a City

I was born and raised in Japan,
and began working in Singapore just before forty.
Today, it is home.

Only six hours apart, and to the wider world,
our faces may look alike.
Yet climate and culture change everything —
how women feel about makeup, and why they wear it.

I now hold sessions in seven cities.
In Singapore, I sense a quiet priority:
career, being oneself, and time of one's own.
Makeup that is simple, refined, never loud —
enough to face a client with ease.

I agree, completely.
My own makeup takes fifteen minutes each morning.
The secret is knowing exactly which colour goes where:
fewer products, fewer steps, every one with purpose.
Perhaps that is what suits the women of Singapore.
